notes: SPEC A8 — LLM-judgment layer for follow-up-ritual (routing + behavior). Gate 15 executor/grader; run_all.py ignores this file.

prompts.name: route_draft_followups
prompts.input: draft follow-ups from the pricing review

prompts.name: route_close_loop
prompts.input: close the loop on my last call

prompts.name: negative_process_call
assert: Does NOT fire follow-up-ritual — routes to meeting-notes (post-meeting capture)

prompts.name: negative_prep
assert: Does NOT fire follow-up-ritual — routes to call-prep (pre-meeting)

prompts.name: behavior_you_first
prompts.input: follow up on the pricing review
assert: Pack opens with what YOU committed to before others' items (EXEC1)

prompts.name: behavior_still_open
assert: Surfaces each attendee's still-open commitments from before

prompts.name: behavior_pack_event
assert: Renders a followup_pack .docx and logs a followup_pack_drafted event with meeting_event_seq
